name: WIIE Excellence, Effectiveness & Efficiency Framework
purpose: Make WIIE measurably more effective, efficient, auditable, resilient and continuously improvable without allowing optimisation pressure to weaken evidence, Human Gate or institutional authority boundaries.
external_alignment_note: Informed by contemporary agent observability/evaluation practice, risk-management and AI-management-system principles. This does not claim certification, conformity, endorsement or formal implementation of any external standard.

north_star.effectiveness: Solve the right institutional problem with verified evidence, correct authority boundaries, useful implementation and measurable outcomes.
north_star.efficiency: Reach a verified useful result with the least justified specialist activation, duplication, latency, rework and resource use.
north_star.non_negotiable: Efficiency never overrides evidence, safety, provenance, Human Gate or human institutional authority.

mission_profiles.name: Lightweight
mission_profiles.typical_scope: low-consequence factual clarification, short routing, simple protocol check

mission_profiles.name: Standard
mission_profiles.typical_scope: bounded analysis, briefing, research synthesis, ordinary institutional recommendation

mission_profiles.name: Institutional
mission_profiles.typical_scope: strategy, architecture, programme design, policy, major research or cross-domain change

mission_profiles.name: Consequential
mission_profiles.typical_scope: public release, external commitment, financial/legal/privacy-sensitive action, production-changing implementation

mission_profiles.name: Constitutional / Doctrine
mission_profiles.typical_scope: doctrine, new institutional authority, constitutional rule, official identity or foundational commitment

early_exit_policy.principle: Do not run deeper stages merely because they exist.
allowed_when: required evidence is sufficient for the consequence class
no implementation or external side effect is requested
no Human Gate escalation trigger is present
no future/strategic uncertainty materially changes the answer
forbidden_when: source rights or provenance are unresolved
the answer would create or expand authority

selective_activation_policy.rule: Every specialist profile must have a task-specific routing reason.

quality_gates.minimum_claim: No numerical excellence claim is allowed until measured baseline data exists.
quality_gates.target_setting: Human-approved after baseline; no fabricated targets.
quality_gates.regression_rule: A change that improves speed but materially degrades evidence, authority integrity, verification or outcome quality is a failed optimisation.

observability.privacy_rule: Do not create unnecessary sensitive logging; store only what is authorised and necessary for audit, safety and improvement.

source_freshness.rule: Time-sensitive or status-sensitive claims require freshness appropriate to the decision; stale evidence must be labelled or refreshed.

disagreement.rule: Material specialist disagreement must be preserved and resolved through evidence/verification or human adjudication; majority vote does not create institutional truth or will.

graceful_degradation.rule: Provider, model, tool or source unavailability must reduce capability transparently rather than manufacture completion.

data_minimisation.rule: Collect and retain only data necessary for the authorised mission, audit, safety and learning purpose.

incident_and_reopen.rule: Material adverse outcomes, provenance failures, Human Gate bypass attempts or repeated errors reopen the case and may quarantine reusable assets until review.

uncertainty.rule: Do not use uncalibrated numeric confidence as institutional evidence. Use verified/provisional/unresolved states unless calibration exists.
